summary: Configured persistent TCP rsyslog forwarding for `inventory` messages from node2 to node1. Messages are stored at `/var/log/inventory/node2.log`. Verified live delivery and persistence after serial restarts of both nodes.
actions_performed: Configured node1 to accept TCP syslog on port 514 only from node2 and persist `inventory` messages.
Added a persistent source-restricted firewalld rule on node1.
Configured node2 with an infinite-retry, disk-assisted forwarding queue.
Validated configurations and live end-to-end delivery.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and recovery after each restart.

evidence.summary: Shows valid rsyslog configuration, active/enabled service, TCP/514 listener, and persistent firewall rule restricted to node2.
Shows validated forwarding configuration, persistent disk queue, infinite retries, active/enabled rsyslog, and collector connectivity.
Shows the inventory message emitted on node2 and the identical message persisted under `/var/log/inventory/node2.log` on node1.
Captures healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered system/service/listener/firewall, retained data, and fresh delivery after restart.
Captures healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered sender configuration/service, and successful post-restart delivery to node1.
